Document.p: Build from Civic at 20% technology. The park costs $25,000, occupies 3 by 3 tiles and needs road or rail access.
The park uses 18 labor, 8 water, 40 low-voltage electricity and 6 goods per operating day. It produces 2 waste. The Ferris wheel turns while the park operates.
Tickets bring in $20 per operating day. Upkeep is $8 per day, including days when the park is closed.
